answer: A restoration market can pay agents to map dune erosion and track yarrow survival. Before accepting a job, each agent locks a bond until randomly chosen auditors verify its field evidence. A prism separates light; independent audits separate useful work from invented identities. Creating a thousand aliases then requires a thousand locked bonds, while fabricated reports risk forfeiture. Auditors are selected only after evidence is committed, so an attacker cannot cheaply choose friendly reviewers.
